about: Every gate test, its tier, its measured wall time on the development machine (32 cores, 45 GB; seconds, with the other agents' load of the day), what it covers and its command. The single source of truth for tools/gate.sh and tools/tests_for.py; tests/TIERS.md explains the tiers. Commands run from the repository root; {out} is the test's own out dir and {tmp} its scratch dir (tools/gate.sh makes both). `game` is the number of game clients it runs at once (they queue on the slot pool, control/soaslot.py). `area` is what a change must touch for tools/tests_for.py to pick it (T1); `apis` come from tests/impact.json; `apis: false` marks a test that talks to no server. `known` is a failure that exists without the change being gated (the reason): tools/gate.sh reports it as KNOWN and doesn't fail on it. `requires` lists paths the test needs (missing: tools/gate.sh reports it SKIP and doesn't run it). Kind `platform`: a test of another platform's build (the Windows `win:*` tests, scripts/windows-test.sh): run by its tier, never picked by tools/tests_for.py (no impact entry).

tiers.T0: every commit: the build, the fast deterministic checks (about a minute)
tiers.T1: per change: T0, then what tools/tests_for.py selects for the changed paths (minutes)
tiers.T2: per batch, before merging to main: T0, the full tests/diff, the broad session set, smoke, the emulator and viewer gates (tens of minutes)
tiers.T3: occasional (nightly, before a release): the slow or rarely affected ones

tests.name: build
tests.cmd: scripts/build.sh --target soa soa-server soa-emu soa-viewer soa-webview-render soaruntime_tests soa_env_tests soa_zip_tests soa_codec_tests soa_gamefiles_tests soa_cli_tests
tests.covers: the incremental build (0.1 s with nothing to do; a header change rebuilds minutes)
